Bitdefender is a cybersecurity leader delivering best-in-class threat prevention, detection, and response solutions worldwide. Guardian over millions of consumer, enterprise, and government environments, Bitdefender is one of the industry’s most trusted experts for eliminating threats, protecting privacy, digital identity and data, and enabling cyber resilience. With deep investments in research and development, Bitdefender Labs discovers hundreds of new threats each minute and validates billions of threat queries daily. The company has pioneered breakthrough innovations in antimalware, IoT security, behavioral analytics, and artificial intelligence and its technology is licensed by more than 180 of the world’s most recognized technology brands. Founded in 2001, Bitdefender has customers in 170+ countries with offices around the world. For more information, visit https://www.bitdefender.com Role Summary The Salesforce Developer builds, and maintains scalable Salesforce solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Partner/Experience Cloud. This role is hands-on and delivery-focused, contributing high-quality code and configurations while collaborating closely with the Salesforce Technical Lead, Admins, Business Analysts, and QA. Key Responsibilities Solution Development   Develop Apex classes, triggers, LWCs, Flows, and validation logic following best practices, given by the solution architect or the team lead; Implement secure and scalable data models, automation, and UI components.   Code Quality & Standards   Produce clean, maintainable, and testable code aligned with platform and COE standards; Write unit tests and ensure adequate test coverage for all custom development; Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback from the Technical Lead and peers.   Collaboration & Delivery   Work closely with Salesforce Admins to ensure proper balance between configuration and code; Partner with QA to support testing, bug fixes, and regression validation.   Operational Support   Investigate and resolve production issues with appropriate root cause analysis; Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing within the team; Support continuous improvement initiatives, refactoring, and technical debt reduction.   Required Qualifications Technical Skills   Understanding of spreadsheets/relational data (rows, columns, keys), basic import/export; A very gentle intro to SOQL, SOSL (just reading/writing simple queries); Basic DataBase knowledge; JAVA and JAVASCRIPT basics.   Professional Competencies   Ability to work independently on assigned tasks with supervision from team leader or solution architect; Attention to detail; Clear written and verbal communication in a cross-functional environment; Comfortable working in an agile/Scrum delivery model.   Success Indicators   Consistent delivery of high-quality features on time; Low defect rates and strong test coverage; Effective collaboration with Tech Lead, Admins, and QA; Growing technical autonomy and contribution to team best practices.
